download.title: Download Pindou Desktop
download.tagline: The offline editor for fuse bead patterns
download.heroDescription: The desktop app brings the full editor to your device — draw, convert images, and export charts without an account or a network connection.
download.macNote: The app is not code-signed yet (beta). If macOS says the app is damaged, right-click it in Finder, choose Open, then click Open again — or run:
download.winNote: SmartScreen may warn about an unknown publisher. Click More info, then Run anyway.
download.otherNote: Downloads are available for Apple Silicon Macs and 64-bit Windows. For anything else, browse the release assets on GitHub.
